description.value: The study investigated F-Flortaucipir retention in svPPA and C9orf72 mutation carriers using ROI-based and voxel-wise PET analyses, with healthy controls for comparison.

spans.text: We therefore recruited six   C9orf72   expansion carriers, six svPPA patients, and 54 healthy controls.

description.value: Participants included six C9orf72 expansion carriers, six svPPA patients, and 54 healthy controls; all underwent F-Flortaucipir PET and MRI scanning.

spans.text: All underwent  F-Flortaucipir PET and MRI scanning.

The study participants were recruited from the Neurology and Memory clinics at Skåne University Hospital and from the memory clinic at Ängelholm Hospital, Sweden as part of the ongoing Swedish BioFINDER study (  www.biofinder.se  ).

We included: 1) six patients with svPPA diagnosed according to international criteria , three with left sided dominant syndrome (L-svPPA) and three with the right sided dominant syndrome (“right semantic dementia”, R-SD) .

value: In the C9orf72-mutation carriers > control contrast there was one small cluster located in the right posterior limb of the internal capsule.
The significance of this cluster is uncertain, but it colocalizes to a region with atrophy on MRI-based measures in C9orf72 patients.
